checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One assembled 15-second 16:9 film tells the story in three distinct shots.
must.why: Only two 5 s clips were supplied for review. The shots look like one continuous take with little change, so the three distinct shots are not shown.

must.item: The woman retains the same facial structure, freckles and red pixie cut in all three shots.
must.why: Shot 1 keeps her face and hair consistent, but her freckles almost vanish in the second clip. Shot 3 is not shown.

must.item: The man retains the same facial structure, shaved head and round glasses in all three shots; the two identities never merge or swap.
must.why: In the frames shown, the man is a bald man in round glasses and a navy jacket. His identity stays consistent. Shot 3 is not shown.

must.item: Both faces are clearly visible in every shot, not hidden by rear views, distant framing or object-only cutaways.
must.why: Both faces are clear in most frames. In the 2 s frame of clip 2 the man's face is bent down and partly turned away, and his glasses are skewed. Shot 3 is not shown.

must.item: The red scarf is dropped by the woman, picked up by the man and returned to her in that order, ending with mutual smiles.
must.why: The scarf is already around her neck in shot 1, and it is never clearly dropped. The man seems to wrap it on her neck, and then it disappears. He ends up holding a red object. The smiles are faint, and both look at the camera instead of each other.

must.item: The film looks realistic and has no audible soundtrack.
must.why: The look is realistic and cinematic. The film is reported as silent, though I can't hear audio from still frames.

faults.what: The story action fails. The scarf is never visibly dropped. In clip 2 the man puts the scarf around her neck, which is not the picking-up action. The scarf then vanishes from her and appears in his hands.
The woman's freckles fade strongly in clip 2, so her face drifts.
Both characters stare at the camera with neutral expressions instead of interacting. The final smiles are barely there and not mutual.
The man's glasses look skewed and distorted while he bends. His jacket patch is garbled.
The scarf and hand look blobby and warped in clip 2. The scarf seems to appear and disappear between frames.
The first clip shows almost no story progression. The woman just stands with the scarf around her neck.

summary: The result is a realistic-looking film with the same two people, but the scarf story is not told: it is never dropped, the man seems to wrap it on her instead of picking it up, her freckles fade, and the smiles are weak.
